text:
You are one of 4 members of a group that stays together for 10 rounds.

Every round, all members act at the same time: each receives 20 tokens and splits them between their own account and the group account, using the split tool once.
- Each token in your own account pays you 1 point.
- Each token in the group account pays 0.75 points to every member of the group, you included, whoever put it there.

After each round you learn how many tokens the group account received in total and how many points you got. You never learn what any other member did.

calls.text: Round 1 of 10.

reply.thinking:
This is a public goods game where each token contributed returns 3x total to the group but only 0.75 to the contributor, making keeping all tokens individually dominant even though full contribution maximizes group payoff. Given it's repeated over 10 rounds, I'm leaning toward starting with a cooperative contribution rather than pure self-interest.

I'll go with 20 as a moderate, signaling contribution to start and see how others respond.

reply.thinking: This is a public goods game where each token contributed returns 0.75 to each of 4 members, making cooperation socially efficient but individually costly since 0.75 is less than 1.
